# v1 vault fixture provenance

`vault.env` preserves three real variable names harvested on 2026-09-12 from the
active v1 `~/.claude/vault.env`, a canonical v1 location confirmed by
`ARCHIVE-MAP.md`. Every value was replaced manually with the exact `REDACTED`
sentinel before this fixture entered the repository. The importer intentionally
refuses that sentinel, so this committed evidence can never be mistaken for usable
credentials or imported by accident.
